tools.name: get_top_articles
tools.description: Get the top-ranked engineering articles (default Top 10) from the alekseialeinikov.com leaderboard, ranked by verified 30-day or 7-day readership and AI tool lookups. Use this whenever a user asks for the most-read, popular, trending, or top 10 articles rather than keyword search. Supports optional

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_articles" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search Aleksei Aleinikov engineering articles (EN/DE) on Google Cloud, Kubernetes/GKE, Cloud Security, Architecture, PostgreSQL, AI/LLM, and Hardware Lab. Use t…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
